figs.name: mems-accelerometer-differential-capacitive-sensing-diagram
figs.alt: MEMS accelerometer proof mass on flexure springs between fixed electrodes forming C1 and C2
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the silicon proof mass on flexure springs between fixed electrodes, so acceleration raises C1 and lowers C2 in proportion to displacement.
figs.after_h2: MEMS Accelerometer Working Principle: Capacitive Sensing

figs.name: mems-accelerometer-key-numbers-infographic
figs.alt: MEMS accelerometer displacement, resonant frequency, resolution and noise worked numbers
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog summarising the article numbers: 0.981 nm displacement at 1g, 15,900 Hz resonance, 0.488 mg resolution and 3.2 mg RMS noise.
figs.after_h2: Key Electrical Parameters for MEMS Accelerometer Selection
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>MEMS accelerometer key numbers and formulas from the worked example</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">MEMS Accelerometer Numbers That Matter</text>
<rect x="30" y="64" width="360" height="216" rx="16" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="210" y="126" font-size="36" fill="#7c3aed" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0.981 nm</text>
<text x="210" y="164" font-size="19" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Displacement at 1g</text>
<line x1="70" y1="184" x2="350" y2="184" stroke="#ddd6fe" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210" y="220" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">x = m × a ÷ k</text>
<text x="210" y="252" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">m = 1 microgram, k = 10 N/m</text>
<rect x="410" y="64" width="360" height="216" rx="16" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="590" y="126" font-size="36" fill="#7c3aed" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">15,900 Hz</text>
<text x="590" y="164" font-size="19" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Resonant frequency</text>
<line x1="450" y1="184" x2="730" y2="184" stroke="#ddd6fe" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="590" y="220" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">f = (1 ÷ 2π) × √(k ÷ m)</text>
<text x="590" y="252" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">usable band about 30 %, 5 kHz</text>
<rect x="30" y="300" width="360" height="216" rx="16" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="210" y="362" font-size="36" fill="#7c3aed" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0.488 mg</text>
<text x="210" y="400" font-size="19" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Resolution per LSB</text>
<line x1="70" y1="420" x2="350" y2="420" stroke="#ddd6fe" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210" y="456" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">32 g span ÷ 65,536 counts</text>
<text x="210" y="488" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">16 bit ADC, ±16 g range</text>
<rect x="410" y="300" width="360" height="216" rx="16" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="590" y="362" font-size="36" fill="#7c3aed" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3.2 mg</text>
<text x="590" y="400" font-size="19" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RMS noise</text>
<line x1="450" y1="420" x2="730" y2="420" stroke="#ddd6fe" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="590" y="456" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">100 ug/√Hz × √1000 Hz</text>
<text x="590" y="488" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">noise grows with bandwidth</text>
</svg>
